All four adjacent tiles report "nothing-there" — meaning the notice board is NOT on any adjacent tile, it's on my own tile (2,7). And I can't move off it.

This is a genuine trap. But wait — the map shows (2,7) as walkable '@'. Let me reconsider: maybe the movement IS working but the observe is stale, OR maybe the notice board is a "blocks" object that I'm standing on and the game won't let me leave.

Let me try the walk_to to a far tile and watch the leg count — earlier it did 14 legs. That means it IS attempting movement. Let me try walking to (2,6) directly with stand mode.
